description: Machine-readable verification recipes for Claude OS sprint execution. Command placeholders are marked with TODO and must be confirmed against actual repo commands before use.

recipes.purpose: Verify TypeScript compilation across the workspace
recipes.when_required: Always — every sprint must pass type check
recipes.evidence_expected: Full tsc output captured to proof_typecheck.txt showing 0 errors, or errors documented with justification
recipes.notes: This is the minimum verification gate. No sprint proceeds with type errors unless explicitly justified in the sprint contract.

recipes.purpose: Verify code style and lint rules
recipes.when_required: All sprints that modify TypeScript/JavaScript files
recipes.evidence_expected: Lint output captured to proof_lint.txt showing no new errors
recipes.command_placeholder: TODO: confirm lint command (likely npm run lint or eslint-specific)
recipes.notes: Pre-existing lint warnings (e.g., 7 known security/detect-non-literal-fs-filename warnings) are acceptable. New lint errors are not.

recipes.purpose: Run unit tests for changed code paths
recipes.when_required: Sprints that modify code with existing unit test coverage
recipes.evidence_expected: Full test runner output captured to proof_tests.txt showing test results
recipes.notes: For targeted runs, document which test files were executed and why full suite was not required.

recipes.purpose: Run integration tests for cross-component changes
recipes.when_required: Sprints that modify cross-component boundaries or shared packages
recipes.evidence_expected: Full integration test output captured to proof_tests_integration.txt
recipes.notes: Integration tests may require running services. If services are unavailable, document as a fail-closed condition.

recipes.purpose: Verify that affected applications build successfully
recipes.when_required: Sprints that modify application or package code
recipes.evidence_expected: Build output captured to proof_build.txt showing successful compilation/bundling
recipes.notes: For targeted builds, use workspace-specific commands (e.g., npm run build --workspace=apps/api). Document which builds were run.

recipes.when_required: Sprints that touch unified_picks, lifecycle adapters, or any file in apps/api/src/ that could write to unified_picks
recipes.evidence_expected: Gate output captured to proof_gate.txt showing GATE PASSED with 0 violations
recipes.notes: This is a non-negotiable invariant from CLAUDE_EXECUTION_CONTRACT.md. Gate failure = sprint cannot proceed.

recipes.purpose: Verify basic runtime behavior of the API
recipes.when_required: T3+ verification tier sprints that change API runtime behavior
recipes.evidence_expected: API response captures or runtime log output saved to proof_runtime_smoke.txt
recipes.command_placeholder: TODO: define runtime smoke test command (depends on running environment)
recipes.notes: Requires running API instance. If unavailable, document as fail-closed condition per Rule 6.

recipes.purpose: Verify Discord embed delivery format and routing
recipes.when_required: Sprints that modify Discord embed building, delivery, or channel routing
recipes.evidence_expected: Discord embed screenshot or API response saved to proofs/ directory
recipes.command_placeholder: TODO: define Discord canary verification (manual capture or test channel delivery)
recipes.notes: May require manual capture. If Discord bot is offline, document as fail-closed condition.

recipes.purpose: Verify UI renders correctly after changes
recipes.when_required: Sprints that modify command-center, dashboard, or smart-form UI components
recipes.evidence_expected: Screenshot of affected UI in proofs/screenshots/ directory
recipes.command_placeholder: TODO: define UI verification method (dev server + screenshot capture)
recipes.notes: Visual verification is inherently manual for v1. Automated visual regression is a v2 consideration.

recipes.purpose: Verify database schema matches TypeScript type expectations
recipes.when_required: Sprints that modify database schema or Supabase type definitions
recipes.evidence_expected: Schema comparison output or Supabase type generation output saved to proof file
recipes.command_placeholder: TODO: define schema guard command (likely supabase gen types or schema comparison script)
recipes.notes: Schema drift between types and actual database is a critical failure class. See System Law 8.

recipes.purpose: Detect governance drift — discrepancies between documented state and actual state
recipes.when_required: All T3+ sprints, and any sprint that modifies docs/system/current/ or docs/contracts/
recipes.evidence_expected: Audit report noting any detected drift or confirming no drift found
recipes.command_placeholder: TODO: define drift audit procedure (manual review against audit-agent.md checklist)
recipes.notes: Drift detection is currently manual. Automated drift detection is deferred to Phase D.
